name: Lovable
description: Describe the app you want in plain language and Lovable builds a working web app you can look at, edit and publish. Free tier available; more usage needs a paid plan.

name: Bolt
description: StackBlitz's in-browser builder: type an idea and get a runnable web app in a real dev environment, with the option to keep editing the code yourself.

name: v0
description: Vercel's prompt-to-interface tool. It generates React and Tailwind interfaces and pages, then hands them to you as code you can drop into a project.

name: Replit
description: A browser development workspace whose Agent builds, tests and deploys an app from a description, all without installing anything locally.

name: Base44
description: An AI app builder for internal tools and small products: describe the database, screens and rules and it assembles a hosted app. Not affiliated with base31.org.

name: Framer
description: A visual website builder with AI that drafts pages, copy and layouts from a prompt, then lets you fine-tune every element by hand and publish to your own domain.

name: Durable
description: Generates a small business website — pages, copy and images — in a minute or two from a few answers, with hosting and paid plans for extras.

name: Hostinger Horizons
description: A chat-driven builder for web apps and sites that hosts what you make. Describe the change you want instead of hunting through settings.

name: Glide
description: Turns a spreadsheet or database into a phone-friendly app or portal for a team, with AI helping lay out screens and write formulas.

name: Softr
description: Builds client portals, member areas and internal tools on top of Airtable, Google Sheets or a database — no code, with AI generating the starting blocks.

name: Zapier Agents
description: Zapier's no-code agents and automations: connect the apps you already use and let an AI agent watch for events, decide and act on your behalf.

name: Gumloop
description: A visual, no-code canvas for chaining AI and everyday tools into repeatable workflows — scraping, sorting, summarising and sending on a schedule.
